title: feat: gpu gauge counts the export session

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: gpu gauge counts the export session

description: The system strip's GPU figure read only the preview session's GL_TIME_ELAPSED counter (the device GPU-busy sysfs is blocked for apps), so an export, which runs entirely in the develop session, showed a dash although it was GPU work. The develop session now keeps the same per-frame TIME_ELAPSED ring around its frame jobs (readback and encoder), accumulating into its own counter; nativePreviewGpuNanos returns the preview and export counters summed (unknown only when neither session has a working timer). Device: during an export the strip shows GPU 93% then 71% and CPU 31-33% instead of a dash. Accuracy is NOT verified: the query scope may include time the GPU spends waiting inside the frame job, so the figure can overstate the load.
changed: feat: gpu gauge counts the export session
